text.card: A red giant 1,992 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.06 solar masses and 6.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,843 K at its surface.
